title: Strip bracketed promptstyle directives before word alignment tokenization

violation.problem: extractWordTimingsFromPcm tokenizes bracketed style instructions (e.g. [style: whisper]) as spoken words, creating phantom word timestamps, advancing wordIndex by 2, and corrupting transcript synchronization.
violation.expectedSolution: Filter out bracketed prompt directives from text before tokenizing spoken words so that only true spoken words receive timing metadata.

steps: In src/audio/player/word-aligner.ts, inside extractWordTimingsFromPcm(), sanitize or filter bracketed prompt directives (e.g. [style: ...] or [...]) before tokenizing spoken words.
Ensure word indices start at 0 for the first true spoken word.
Preserve accurate character start and end offsets mapped to the spoken words in the text.
reviewChecklist: Bracket directives like [style: whisper] produce zero word timing entries
Spoken words start at wordIndex 0 with accurate character offsets
Existing word alignment calculations and smoothing logic remain intact
